meta.title: Receding Refraction
meta.description: When light passes through the infinite cosmos, what does it hide and what does it expose?

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, Uranian space.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, Uranian space.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, Uranian space.

units.rawText: Warning! Entropized comets sighted at 5 o'clock, range 40. Please evade.
units.displayText: Warning! Entropized comets sighted at 5 o'clock, range 40. Please evade.

spans.text: Warning! Entropized comets sighted at 5 o'clock, range 40. Please evade.

units.rawText: ...They're so persistent...
units.displayText: ...They're so persistent...

spans.text: ...They're so persistent...

units.rawText: Fresnel maxes out the spaceship's throttle on the control terminal. However, one comet trailing an eldritch purple light in its wake continues its dogged pursuit of the vessel.
units.displayText: Fresnel maxes out the spaceship's throttle on the control terminal. However, one comet trailing an eldritch purple light in its wake continues its dogged pursuit of the vessel.

spans.text: Fresnel maxes out the spaceship's throttle on the control terminal. However, one comet trailing an eldritch purple light in its wake continues its dogged pursuit of the vessel.

units.rawText: Starboard cannon, reload!
units.displayText: Starboard cannon, reload!

spans.text: Starboard cannon, reload!

units.rawText: Weapon emplacement is cooling down, estimated cooldown time of 260 seconds needed before charging can commence!
units.displayText: Weapon emplacement is cooling down, estimated cooldown time of 260 seconds needed before charging can commence!

spans.text: Weapon emplacement is cooling down, estimated cooldown time of 260 seconds needed before charging can commence!

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: Countless points of light spray forth from the comet. Bizarre entropic creatures spread their claws, roaring as they swoop down on the spaceship.
units.displayText: Countless points of light spray forth from the comet. Bizarre entropic creatures spread their claws, roaring as they swoop down on the spaceship.

spans.text: Countless points of light spray forth from the comet. Bizarre entropic creatures spread their claws, roaring as they swoop down on the spaceship.

units.rawText: Not good... there are too many entropics coming after us. The spaceship's guns alone can't handle them.
units.displayText: Not good... there are too many entropics coming after us. The spaceship's guns alone can't handle them.

spans.text: Not good... there are too many entropics coming after us. The spaceship's guns alone can't handle them.

units.rawText: More to that point, there's a never-ending supply of entropic comets out there; it's going to be bad if the entropics spread out and encircle us!
units.displayText: More to that point, there's a never-ending supply of entropic comets out there; it's going to be bad if the entropics spread out and encircle us!

spans.text: More to that point, there's a never-ending supply of entropic comets out there; it's going to be bad if the entropics spread out and encircle us!

units.rawText: If the light within the room cannot light up the darkness, then let the light of day shine in from outside.
units.displayText: If the light within the room cannot light up the darkness, then let the light of day shine in from outside.

spans.text: If the light within the room cannot light up the darkness, then let the light of day shine in from outside.

units.rawText: True, if we had external fire support to clear out these entropics...
units.displayText: True, if we had external fire support to clear out these entropics...

spans.text: True, if we had external fire support to clear out these entropics...

units.rawText: That's right! We have an exo! The one Belka brought aboard, the one from Oberon!
units.displayText: That's right! We have an exo! The one Belka brought aboard, the one from Oberon!

spans.text: That's right! We have an exo! The one Belka brought aboard, the one from Oberon!

units.rawText: But isn't that a civilian field expedition model?
units.displayText: But isn't that a civilian field expedition model?

spans.text: But isn't that a civilian field expedition model?

units.rawText: The standard exo still has some degree of firepower on it, and...
units.displayText: The standard exo still has some degree of firepower on it, and...

spans.text: The standard exo still has some degree of firepower on it, and...

units.rawText: Xinghuan glances at the heavy guns in the corner of the ship's hold.
units.displayText: Xinghuan glances at the heavy guns in the corner of the ship's hold.

spans.text: Xinghuan glances at the heavy guns in the corner of the ship's hold.

units.rawText: Why do you have a "Hellbore Cannon" on your ship?
units.displayText: Why do you have a "Hellbore Cannon" on your ship?

spans.text: Why do you have a "Hellbore Cannon" on your ship?

units.rawText: It's a secret weapon a friend from the Oasis gave us for self-defense... Looks like Croque's hunch was right.
units.displayText: It's a secret weapon a friend from the Oasis gave us for self-defense... Looks like Croque's hunch was right.

spans.text: It's a secret weapon a friend from the Oasis gave us for self-defense... Looks like Croque's hunch was right.

units.rawText: Well, since it's a secret self-defense weapon, then we ought to bring it out before it gets rusty!
units.displayText: Well, since it's a secret self-defense weapon, then we ought to bring it out before it gets rusty!

spans.text: Well, since it's a secret self-defense weapon, then we ought to bring it out before it gets rusty!

units.rawText: Xinghuan, you haven't fully recovered yet; please don't push yourself too hard.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, you haven't fully recovered yet; please don't push yourself too hard.

spans.text: Xinghuan, you haven't fully recovered yet; please don't push yourself too hard.

units.rawText: Relax, just leave it all to the ace taikonaut Xinghuan!
units.displayText: Relax, just leave it all to the ace taikonaut Xinghuan!

spans.text: Relax, just leave it all to the ace taikonaut Xinghuan!

units.rawText: As the spaceship races through the void, more and more comets break off from other planetary systems to chase it.
units.displayText: As the spaceship races through the void, more and more comets break off from other planetary systems to chase it.

spans.text: As the spaceship races through the void, more and more comets break off from other planetary systems to chase it.

units.rawText: Swarms of entropics flood out from the comers in all directions, and it seems as though the spaceship is going to drown in a dark purple sea of Entropy.
units.displayText: Swarms of entropics flood out from the comers in all directions, and it seems as though the spaceship is going to drown in a dark purple sea of Entropy.

spans.text: Swarms of entropics flood out from the comers in all directions, and it seems as though the spaceship is going to drown in a dark purple sea of Entropy.

units.rawText: Target locked... Fire!
units.displayText: Target locked... Fire!

spans.text: Target locked... Fire!

units.rawText: <size=40>Boom!</size>
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: The sudden explosion freezes the pursuing entropics in their tracks, and they stop to look around their surroundings.
units.displayText: The sudden explosion freezes the pursuing entropics in their tracks, and they stop to look around their surroundings.

spans.text: The sudden explosion freezes the pursuing entropics in their tracks, and they stop to look around their surroundings.

units.rawText: Hss?!
units.displayText: Hss?!

spans.text: Hss?!

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A white machine soars out of the spaceship's hold, taking an escort formation behind the vessel.
units.displayText: A white machine soars out of the spaceship's hold, taking an escort formation behind the vessel.

spans.text: A white machine soars out of the spaceship's hold, taking an escort formation behind the vessel.

units.rawText: Fresnel was right, turns out your next move was to split up and encircle us.
units.displayText: Fresnel was right, turns out your next move was to split up and encircle us.

spans.text: Fresnel was right, turns out your next move was to split up and encircle us.

units.rawText: Grah!!
units.displayText: Grah!!

spans.text: Grah!!

units.rawText: As the entropics begin to pincer attack the spaceship, Xinghuan's cannon has already targeted their intended course.
units.displayText: As the entropics begin to pincer attack the spaceship, Xinghuan's cannon has already targeted their intended course.

spans.text: As the entropics begin to pincer attack the spaceship, Xinghuan's cannon has already targeted their intended course.

units.rawText: Cannon blasts mercilessly consume the enemy, but those ominous comets continue spawning new entropics.
units.displayText: Cannon blasts mercilessly consume the enemy, but those ominous comets continue spawning new entropics.

spans.text: Cannon blasts mercilessly consume the enemy, but those ominous comets continue spawning new entropics.

units.rawText: Reloading... ugh...
units.displayText: Reloading... ugh...

spans.text: Reloading... ugh...

units.rawText: Xinghuan has only lightly nudged her control stick when waves of pain begin spreading out from her left arm.
units.displayText: Xinghuan has only lightly nudged her control stick when waves of pain begin spreading out from her left arm.

spans.text: Xinghuan has only lightly nudged her control stick when waves of pain begin spreading out from her left arm.

units.rawText: (Groans and grunts)
units.displayText: Groans and grunts

spans.text: Groans and grunts

units.rawText: In just a moment, the entropic hordes have broken through the web of firepower Xinghuan has laid down and have rushed up to the spaceship's port side. Their sharp-tipped tentacles take aim at the spaceship's weaknesses.
units.displayText: In just a moment, the entropic hordes have broken through the web of firepower Xinghuan has laid down and have rushed up to the spaceship's port side. Their sharp-tipped tentacles take aim at the spaceship's weaknesses.

spans.text: In just a moment, the entropic hordes have broken through the web of firepower Xinghuan has laid down and have rushed up to the spaceship's port side. Their sharp-tipped tentacles take aim at the spaceship's weaknesses.

units.rawText: <size=40>GET LOST!</size>
units.displayText: GET LOST!

spans.text: GET LOST!

units.rawText: Xinghuan pushes her throttle forward all the way and a powerful surge from the exo-armor's thrusters throw it forward. The massive frame of the exo crashes into an entropic that's about to penetrate the spaceship's hull and sends it flying.
units.displayText: Xinghuan pushes her throttle forward all the way and a powerful surge from the exo-armor's thrusters throw it forward. The massive frame of the exo crashes into an entropic that's about to penetrate the spaceship's hull and sends it flying.

spans.text: Xinghuan pushes her throttle forward all the way and a powerful surge from the exo-armor's thrusters throw it forward. The massive frame of the exo crashes into an entropic that's about to penetrate the spaceship's hull and sends it flying.

units.rawText: (Groans)
units.displayText: Groans

spans.text: Groans

units.rawText: Xinghuan?! Xinghuan, are you okay?!
units.displayText: Xinghuan?! Xinghuan, are you okay?!

spans.text: Xinghuan?! Xinghuan, are you okay?!

units.rawText: I'm fine, just maintain your present velocity...
units.displayText: I'm fine, just maintain your present velocity...

spans.text: I'm fine, just maintain your present velocity...

units.rawText: Xinghuan grabs her stomach. Glowing operands are slowly oozing out of it.
units.displayText: Xinghuan grabs her stomach. Glowing operands are slowly oozing out of it.

spans.text: Xinghuan grabs her stomach. Glowing operands are slowly oozing out of it.

units.rawText: Did your wound open up? This is bad, at this rate you'll...
units.displayText: Did your wound open up? This is bad, at this rate you'll...

spans.text: Did your wound open up? This is bad, at this rate you'll...

units.rawText: I'm fine... what happened just now was just a small mistake.
units.displayText: I'm fine... what happened just now was just a small mistake.

spans.text: I'm fine... what happened just now was just a small mistake.

units.rawText: We can't go on like this. There's an asteroid belt up ahead, we could try hiding there...
units.displayText: We can't go on like this. There's an asteroid belt up ahead, we could try hiding there...

spans.text: We can't go on like this. There's an asteroid belt up ahead, we could try hiding there...

units.rawText: We can't! The debris in the asteroid belt will slow us down, and there are more and more of those comets. If they catch up with us, we won't be able to escape!
units.displayText: We can't! The debris in the asteroid belt will slow us down, and there are more and more of those comets. If they catch up with us, we won't be able to escape!

spans.text: We can't! The debris in the asteroid belt will slow us down, and there are more and more of those comets. If they catch up with us, we won't be able to escape!

units.rawText: Never mind me, you guys should flee at full speed. As long as you can shake off those entropics...
units.displayText: Never mind me, you guys should flee at full speed. As long as you can shake off those entropics...

spans.text: Never mind me, you guys should flee at full speed. As long as you can shake off those entropics...

units.rawText: Xinghuan ignites her beam saber and fends off the enemies' attacks with its blazing edge.
units.displayText: Xinghuan ignites her beam saber and fends off the enemies' attacks with its blazing edge.

spans.text: Xinghuan ignites her beam saber and fends off the enemies' attacks with its blazing edge.

units.rawText: However, all this motion strains her wounds and puts a huge burden on her body. Gradually, Xinghuan begins losing steam under the endless stream of entropic attacks.
units.displayText: However, all this motion strains her wounds and puts a huge burden on her body. Gradually, Xinghuan begins losing steam under the endless stream of entropic attacks.

spans.text: However, all this motion strains her wounds and puts a huge burden on her body. Gradually, Xinghuan begins losing steam under the endless stream of entropic attacks.

units.rawText: Ngh... You shall not pass!
units.displayText: Ngh... You shall not pass!

spans.text: Ngh... You shall not pass!

units.rawText: A hardened tentacle tip bats the beam saber aside. As said tentacle is about to spear the exo's piloting cradle... the spaceship suddenly charges into the entropics.
units.displayText: A hardened tentacle tip bats the beam saber aside. As said tentacle is about to spear the exo's piloting cradle... the spaceship suddenly charges into the entropics.

spans.text: A hardened tentacle tip bats the beam saber aside. As said tentacle is about to spear the exo's piloting cradle... the spaceship suddenly charges into the entropics.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, don't fight them head-on. I have an idea.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, don't fight them head-on. I have an idea.

spans.text: Xinghuan, don't fight them head-on. I have an idea.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Help me delay them for as long as possible, but remember, just tie them up, don't go too far.
units.displayText: Help me delay them for as long as possible, but remember, just tie them up, don't go too far.

spans.text: Help me delay them for as long as possible, but remember, just tie them up, don't go too far.

units.rawText: Understood. I'll do my best to occupy them.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll do my best to occupy them.

spans.text: Understood. I'll do my best to occupy them.

units.rawText: Thank you. X-ARMS activate! Accel on!
units.displayText: Thank you. X-ARMS activate! Accel on!

spans.text: Thank you. X-ARMS activate! Accel on!

units.rawText: The exo-armor begins keeping its distance from the entropic horde, barely staying in weapons range. Meanwhile, the spaceship rushes toward the asteroid belt like a blinking red star.
units.displayText: The exo-armor begins keeping its distance from the entropic horde, barely staying in weapons range. Meanwhile, the spaceship rushes toward the asteroid belt like a blinking red star.

spans.text: The exo-armor begins keeping its distance from the entropic horde, barely staying in weapons range. Meanwhile, the spaceship rushes toward the asteroid belt like a blinking red star.

units.rawText: This position... Good... this is the spot.
units.displayText: This position... Good... this is the spot.

spans.text: This position... Good... this is the spot.

units.rawText: Fresnel slowly parks the OAS-1702 behind a certain asteroid.
units.displayText: Fresnel slowly parks the OAS-1702 behind a certain asteroid.

spans.text: Fresnel slowly parks the OAS-1702 behind a certain asteroid.

units.rawText: What do you have in mind, Fresnel? Xinghuan can't hold on for too long in her current state...
units.displayText: What do you have in mind, Fresnel? Xinghuan can't hold on for too long in her current state...

spans.text: What do you have in mind, Fresnel? Xinghuan can't hold on for too long in her current state...

units.rawText: Ssshh, I need some time to observe the surroundings...
units.displayText: Ssshh, I need some time to observe the surroundings...

spans.text: Ssshh, I need some time to observe the surroundings...

units.rawText: Fresnel turns off the spaceship's engines and lights.
units.displayText: Fresnel turns off the spaceship's engines and lights.

spans.text: Fresnel turns off the spaceship's engines and lights.

units.rawText: Xinghuan's battle with the entropics is visible not far away.
units.displayText: Xinghuan's battle with the entropics is visible not far away.

spans.text: Xinghuan's battle with the entropics is visible not far away.

units.rawText: As I thought, the entropics didn't pursue us. Looks like my hypothesis was right; the comets prioritize locking onto targets within visual range.
units.displayText: As I thought, the entropics didn't pursue us. Looks like my hypothesis was right; the comets prioritize locking onto targets within visual range.

spans.text: As I thought, the entropics didn't pursue us. Looks like my hypothesis was right; the comets prioritize locking onto targets within visual range.

units.rawText: And this is a good place... Hubble, we're going to set up an optical cloak here.
units.displayText: And this is a good place... Hubble, we're going to set up an optical cloak here.

spans.text: And this is a good place... Hubble, we're going to set up an optical cloak here.

units.rawText: Optically cloaking a small area might be possible, but concealing this entire region...
units.displayText: Optically cloaking a small area might be possible, but concealing this entire region...

spans.text: Optically cloaking a small area might be possible, but concealing this entire region...

units.rawText: Remember the optical gear I found on Oberon?
units.displayText: Remember the optical gear I found on Oberon?

spans.text: Remember the optical gear I found on Oberon?

units.rawText: I didn't think they left this much stuff behind... They even have some optical projectors here.
units.displayText: I didn't think they left this much stuff behind... They even have some optical projectors here.

spans.text: I didn't think they left this much stuff behind... They even have some optical projectors here.

units.rawText: Let's just take it all, it might come in handy at some point.
units.displayText: Let's just take it all, it might come in handy at some point.

spans.text: Let's just take it all, it might come in handy at some point.

units.rawText: Since those comets like searching for targets within visual range, we'll just have to keep them from seeing us.
units.displayText: Since those comets like searching for targets within visual range, we'll just have to keep them from seeing us.

spans.text: Since those comets like searching for targets within visual range, we'll just have to keep them from seeing us.

units.rawText: Fresnel... Are you planning to set all this up on the asteroid?
units.displayText: Fresnel... Are you planning to set all this up on the asteroid?

spans.text: Fresnel... Are you planning to set all this up on the asteroid?

units.rawText: Yup. I'll do it while the comets and entropics haven't turned their attention to us yet.
units.displayText: Yup. I'll do it while the comets and entropics haven't turned their attention to us yet.

spans.text: Yup. I'll do it while the comets and entropics haven't turned their attention to us yet.

units.rawText: Understood, I'll help you out, too.
units.displayText: Understood, I'll help you out, too.

spans.text: Understood, I'll help you out, too.

units.rawText: Belka will help, too!
units.displayText: Belka will help, too!

spans.text: Belka will help, too!

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: Xinghuan's hand trembles around the control stick as the Hellbore Cannon fires again, and she starts seeing double images of the screens in front of her.
units.displayText: Xinghuan's hand trembles around the control stick as the Hellbore Cannon fires again, and she starts seeing double images of the screens in front of her.

spans.text: Xinghuan's hand trembles around the control stick as the Hellbore Cannon fires again, and she starts seeing double images of the screens in front of her.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily) Dammit...
units.displayText: (Pants heavily) Dammit...

spans.text: (Pants heavily) Dammit...

units.rawText: Is my body at its limits... even though I'm not even fighting them seriously...
units.displayText: Is my body at its limits... even though I'm not even fighting them seriously...

spans.text: Is my body at its limits... even though I'm not even fighting them seriously...

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Thank you, Xinghuan, it must have been hard on you. Now, I need you to get over to the spaceship's location ASAP.
units.displayText: Thank you, Xinghuan, it must have been hard on you. Now, I need you to get over to the spaceship's location ASAP.

spans.text: Thank you, Xinghuan, it must have been hard on you. Now, I need you to get over to the spaceship's location ASAP.

units.rawText: Alright... Ugh... I'll be right there.
units.displayText: Alright... Ugh... I'll be right there.

spans.text: Alright... Ugh... I'll be right there.

units.rawText:
A white shooting star streaks toward the asteroid belt, and a horde of entropics follows.
During her flight, Xinghuan occasionally fires a shot or two backward to slow the entropics down until she finally approaches her destination.
units.displayText:
A white shooting star streaks toward the asteroid belt, and a horde of entropics follows.
During her flight, Xinghuan occasionally fires a shot or two backward to slow the entropics down until she finally approaches her destination.

spans.text:
A white shooting star streaks toward the asteroid belt, and a horde of entropics follows.
During her flight, Xinghuan occasionally fires a shot or two backward to slow the entropics down until she finally approaches her destination.

units.rawText: Right after Xinghuan's exo enters the asteroid belt—
units.displayText: Right after Xinghuan's exo enters the asteroid belt—

spans.text: Right after Xinghuan's exo enters the asteroid belt—

units.rawText: Deploy smokescreen!
units.displayText: Deploy smokescreen!

spans.text: Deploy smokescreen!

units.rawText: Hsss?!
units.displayText: Hsss?!

spans.text: Hsss?!

units.rawText: Thick smoke engulfs the entropic horde, leaving them unable to tell where they are for a moment.
units.displayText: Thick smoke engulfs the entropic horde, leaving them unable to tell where they are for a moment.

spans.text: Thick smoke engulfs the entropic horde, leaving them unable to tell where they are for a moment.

units.rawText: By the time the smoke clears, the exo they were chasing is nowhere in sight. The only thing that remains in their surroundings are countless drifting asteroids and dead silence.
units.displayText: By the time the smoke clears, the exo they were chasing is nowhere in sight. The only thing that remains in their surroundings are countless drifting asteroids and dead silence.

spans.text: By the time the smoke clears, the exo they were chasing is nowhere in sight. The only thing that remains in their surroundings are countless drifting asteroids and dead silence.

units.rawText: Did they... stop?
units.displayText: Did they... stop?

spans.text: Did they... stop?

units.rawText: What happened?
units.displayText: What happened?

spans.text: What happened?

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Xinghuan sees something completely different. Although she's only a short distance away from the entropics, they're turning around and looking in all directions, as though they can't see her.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, Xinghuan sees something completely different. Although she's only a short distance away from the entropics, they're turning around and looking in all directions, as though they can't see her.

spans.text: Meanwhile, Xinghuan sees something completely different. Although she's only a short distance away from the entropics, they're turning around and looking in all directions, as though they can't see her.

units.rawText: Successfully activated optical cloak.
units.displayText: Successfully activated optical cloak.

spans.text: Successfully activated optical cloak.

units.rawText: Is that... an optical cloak?
units.displayText: Is that... an optical cloak?

spans.text: Is that... an optical cloak?

units.rawText: It is only then that Xinghuan realizes that there are several optical projectors around her, all running at full power.
units.displayText: It is only then that Xinghuan realizes that there are several optical projectors around her, all running at full power.

spans.text: It is only then that Xinghuan realizes that there are several optical projectors around her, all running at full power.

units.rawText: Right now, these entropics are looking at an image we've composited from multiple optical projectors.
units.displayText: Right now, these entropics are looking at an image we've composited from multiple optical projectors.

spans.text: Right now, these entropics are looking at an image we've composited from multiple optical projectors.

units.rawText: To them, we've vanished without a trace.
units.displayText: To them, we've vanished without a trace.

spans.text: To them, we've vanished without a trace.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, lower your thruster output. We'll slowly withdraw from here without revealing ourselves and go to full power once we get some distance away from them.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, lower your thruster output. We'll slowly withdraw from here without revealing ourselves and go to full power once we get some distance away from them.

spans.text: Xinghuan, lower your thruster output. We'll slowly withdraw from here without revealing ourselves and go to full power once we get some distance away from them.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll escort you.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll escort you.

spans.text: Alright, I'll escort you.

units.rawText: The spaceship and the exo slowly make their way forward. The entropic swarm quickly locks onto their next target and heads toward it.
units.displayText: The spaceship and the exo slowly make their way forward. The entropic swarm quickly locks onto their next target and heads toward it.

spans.text: The spaceship and the exo slowly make their way forward. The entropic swarm quickly locks onto their next target and heads toward it.

units.rawText: Whew... A little more and we'll be able to go full throttle and escape.
units.displayText: Whew... A little more and we'll be able to go full throttle and escape.

spans.text: Whew... A little more and we'll be able to go full throttle and escape.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, you should dock with us now.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, you should dock with us now.

spans.text: Xinghuan, you should dock with us now.

units.rawText: Will do, I'm returning now... wha?
units.displayText: Will do, I'm returning now... wha?

spans.text: Will do, I'm returning now... wha?

units.rawText: Pzzzt— Pzzzt— Pzzzt—
units.displayText: Pzzzt— Pzzzt— Pzzzt—

spans.text: Pzzzt— Pzzzt— Pzzzt—

units.rawText: A ripple appears in the optical screen Fresnel erected not far away.
units.displayText: A ripple appears in the optical screen Fresnel erected not far away.

spans.text: A ripple appears in the optical screen Fresnel erected not far away.

units.rawText: A huge mass of mosaicked pixels appears in what should have been empty space, as though something was breaking apart...
units.displayText: A huge mass of mosaicked pixels appears in what should have been empty space, as though something was breaking apart...

spans.text: A huge mass of mosaicked pixels appears in what should have been empty space, as though something was breaking apart...

units.rawText: Fresnel, battle stations!
units.displayText: Fresnel, battle stations!

units.rawText: The asteroids which once milled around in relative stability lose their mutual hold on each other and drift apart like water running out of a puddle, until it completely runs dry...
